Definition: from G4636 and G4078; the Festival of Tabernacles (so called from the custom of erecting booths for temporary homes):--tabernacles.
BiblicalUsage: Skenopegia is the feast of tabernacles, the feast of booths, and it appears once, when the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand and Jesus' brothers urged Him to go up to Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the feast of booths still pointed to the true tabernacle, because the God who once dwelt in a tent was about to walk into Jerusalem.
